readme:
# Zhihu Column Articles API Returns a page of articles from one Zhihu column. Each article includes its title, a text excerpt, an HTML content snippet, vote and comment counts, and author details. The only required input is `column_id`. ## Use cases - Pull the latest posts from a Zhihu column to feed a reading list or newsletter. - Compare `voteup_count` and `comment_count` across a column's articles to find its most popular pieces. - Archive a column's article titles, links and publish times for offline analysis. - Collect author headline and badge data for the writer behind a column. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/zhihu/web/column-articles" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"column_id": "zhangjiawei"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `column_id` | string | Yes | Column ID | | `limit` | string | No | Number of articles per page | | `offset` | string | No | Offset | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "data": [ { "admin_closed_comment": false, "article_type": "normal", "author": { "avatar_url": "https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-d626957872f9b38fa594394db2d2e6e7_l.jpg?source=d16d100b", "avatar_url_template": "https://pic1.zhimg.com/v2-d626957872f9b38fa594394db2d2e6e7.jpg?source=d16d100b", "badge": [ { "description": "优秀答主", "topics": [], "type": "best_answerer" } ], "description": "", "gender": 1, "headline": "公号：张佳玮写字的地方", "id": "f9de84865e3e8455a09af78bfe4d1da5", "is_advertiser": false }, "can_comment": { "reason": "", "status": true }, "comment_count": 54, "comment_permission": "all", "content": "

金庸文人趣味最直白地发作，是《书剑恩仇录》里嘲讽乾隆。

说乾隆…", "content_need_truncated": true, "copyright_permission": "need_review", "created": 1793358930, "excerpt": "金庸文人趣味最直白地发作，是《书剑恩仇录》里嘲讽乾隆。 说乾隆去嫖院： 古往今来，嫖院之人何止千万，却要算乾隆这次嫖得最为规模宏大，当真是好威风，好煞气，于日后…", "excerpt_title": "" } ], "need_force_login": false, "paging": { "is_end": false, "is_start": true, "next": "http://www.zhihu.com/api/v4/columns/zhangjiawei/items?limit=10&ws_qiangzhisafe=0…", "previous": "http://www.zhihu.com/api/v4/columns/zhangjiawei/items?limit=10&ws_qiangzhisafe=0…", "totals": 1560 } } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `data[].title` | Title of the article. | | `data[].url / data[].id` | Link to the article on zhuanlan.zhihu.com and its numeric ID. The ID is also the last part of the URL. | | `data[].excerpt` | Plain-text excerpt of the article, cut short. Images appear as `[图片]`. | | `data[].content` | Start of the article body as HTML. `content_need_truncated` is `true` when the text is cut. | | `data[].voteup_count / data[].comment_count` | Number of upvotes and number of comments on the article. | | `data[].created / data[].updated` | Unix timestamps in seconds for when the article was created and last updated. | | `data[].author.id / data[].author.headline` | ID and short headline of the article's author. | | `data[].author.badge[]` | Badges on the author profile. Each has a `type` and a `description`, such as `best_answerer`. | | `paging.totals` | Total number of articles in the column. | | `paging.is_end / paging.next` | `is_end` is `true` on the last page. `next` is the link to the following page and carries the `limit` and `offset` values. | ## Notes - Take `column_id` from the column's URL slug. This example uses `zhangjiawei`. - Page through results with `limit` and `offset`. The `paging.next` link shows the next `offset`, for example `10` when `limit` is `10`. - Stop paging when `paging.is_end` is `true`. - To get one article in full, call [Zhihu Column Article Detail](/apis/zhihu/web/column-article-detail). ## Pricing $0.001 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization. ## Related APIs - [Zhihu AI Search Stream](/apis/zhihu/web/ai-search-stream): Returns streaming AI search results from Zhihu based on a query prompt. - [Zhihu Answer Details](/apis/zhihu/web/answer-detail): Retrieves detailed information for a specific Zhihu answer using its numeric ID, including answer text, timestamps, and share links. - [Zhihu Article Search](/apis/zhihu/web/article-search-v3): Search Zhihu articles and answers by keyword and get titles, excerpts, authors, vote and comment counts, with sorting, content type and time filters plus offse…
